pages.text: The Golden Land ($(thing)galboss:golden_land$(reset)) is a golden realm entered in Beatrice's Phase 2. Your respawn point is temporarily bound to the arrival spot and cleared automatically upon leaving.$(br2)The $(bold)Return Well$(reset) lies at $(thing)(666, 666)$(reset):$(br)• $(bold)After defeating Beatrice$(reset), jump into the void shaft to return to the Overworld.$(br)• $(bold)During battle$(reset), the barrier warps you back to spawn.

pages.title: Golden Trees
pages.text: Golden Trees made of $(item)Golden Land Log$(reset) and $(item)Golden Land Leaves$(reset) grow around spawn and the Return Well.$(br2)Breaking $(item)Golden Land Leaves$(reset) has a chance to drop:$(br)• $(item)Golden Apple$(reset) (15%, boosted by Fortune)$(br)• $(item)Enchanted Golden Apple$(reset) (3%, boosted by Fortune)
Any $(item)Golden Land Log$(reset) can be broken down directly into a $(item)Totem of Undying$(reset).
